I used Serp via API many moons ago. The most interesting part of the company imo is their legal defense of different plans... 'Our U.S. Legal Shield protects your right to crawl and parse public search engine data under the First Amendment.'
Embedding the API key (secret) in the URL complicates secret management. Please move that to a header and allow setting via env var.
I'm not sure of the legality but I definitely appreciate their product. From what I see SerpApi is really just providing a machine interface that Google themselves refuses to provide users.
SerpApi wouldn't even be a thing if Google offered an equivalent API...
